text:
If you are moving abroad, it's important to close the file properly to prevent any problems in the future (for you, or for your partner), including if you just want to come for a holiday visit. Don't just skip the appointment and then disappear without any explanation :) 

If you are moving away as a couple, the Israeli partner should email PIBA and let them know that you are moving abroad together on X date, that you are still in a relationship, that you want to close the file, and that your renewal appointment will not be necessary. 

If you are moving abroad because your relationship has ended, one of you (ideally the Israeli partner - but you can if they don't want to) must email PIBA and tell them that, and ask to close the file. The procedure is that they will summon both of you to an exit interview - you can ask for it to happen separately if you don't want to go together. They will then give you notice to leave the country within 14 or 30 days.
